items.title: Prediction: Synopsys Could Be a Bigger AI Winner Than Investors Expect
items.summary: Synopsys just posted a record quarter, yet its shares have gone nowhere all year. Between AI chip design, a $10 billion debt load, and export-control worries, one question decides whether the market has this stock badly wrong.

items.title: Buy the dip or wait? BofA maps out 3 scenarios for chip stocks and top picks
